Hi Georges,

Sorry I am working so I might be able to get back to your emails as fast. I am not sure if you got my last email. But I am also having issues with the Nexus S1 now. It keeps turning on and off. I tried to replace the fuse, but it is still not working. I was also supposed to get 1 more Nexus L1 which never arrived. So, I was wondering If I could just get the instore credit to purchase something else if that is ok instead? Let me know. I have been a long-term customer, and I have only had troubles with these Nexus miners so far. Thanks again Georges.

Oliver M,

Sorry Just to clarify again Georges. I am missing 1x Nexus L1 which never shipped to begin with. I also have 1x not working Nexus L1 and also 1x not working Nexus S1. So, 3 units in total. 2 need RMA and 1 was never shipped.
Note to the team: I'll pull Oliver's orders and returns before replying.

Hi Oliver,

Sarah here from HeliumDeploy, picking this up with Georges. Sorry for the trouble with these units, and for how long the L1 has been hanging.

On the faulty Nexus L1 from order Shop····, store credit is absolutely fine. Instead of the DC06 we will put $300.99 of store credit on your HeliumDeploy account, which you can spend on whatever you like at checkout. It is applied as soon as the L1 reaches our warehouse, so please use the prepaid label Georges sent and write Shop···· clearly on the outside of the box. A colleague is taking the DC06 replacement back off today so nothing ships by mistake.

On the Nexus S1 that powers on and off, I have put the warranty return in front of the team for approval first thing today, and they will email you the prepaid label for it. One thing that will speed it up: tell me whether the faulty S1 is the one from your July order Shop···· or the one from March, and I will make sure the right unit is covered.

On the Nexus L1 that never arrived, you are right. It was sent on your July order under UPS tracking ···· on September 9 and the carrier never recorded a delivery. I have asked the team to trace it and settle it with you.

Our team is offline at the moment and starts at 10am Eastern today. They pick these two up then and the answers come straight to this thread.

Thanks for your patience, Oliver.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi,

It has been a couple weeks. Is there an update on the status of my order and RMAs?
Note to the team: Let me re-check the live state of all three units before I reply.

Hi Oliver,

You are right to chase, and I am sorry you have had to. Two weeks with no word from us on this is not good enough.

Where the three units stand. The faulty Nexus L1 from order Shop···· is settled: the DC06 replacement has been cancelled and $300.99 of store credit is set to go onto your HeliumDeploy account the moment that unit reaches our warehouse. Nothing has arrived with us yet, so if the unit is still with you, send it back with Georges' prepaid label and Shop···· written on the box. If that label has gone astray, say the word and we will get a fresh one to you.

The second Nexus L1, the one that never arrived, went out on order Shop···· under UPS tracking ···· on September 9 and the carrier has still never recorded a delivery. That one needs a decision from the team on whether it is re-sent or credited, and they have it first thing this morning.

The Nexus S1 is the one still open on our side. Our technical side has not been able to call it faulty yet, and the return cannot be approved until they do. If you would like that moving today, the fastest route is our Discord at https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf where you can post the symptoms and mention JD, @nullhashrate. He answers hands on there. Otherwise his verdict comes back to you in this thread.

For the wait, I have made you a code for your next order, ····, $50 off, yours alone and valid on orders over $200.

The team is offline right now and starts at 10am Eastern today. The L1 parcel and the S1 are the two things waiting on them, and both answers come to you by email.

Thanks for sticking with us, Oliver.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Hi Oliver,

This is Georges. You have been with us a long time, and the way your Nexus units have been handled is not the standard you should get from us. I'm taking care of your account personally from here.

Here is where everything stands today:

1. The faulty L1 (Shop····): I didn't want you waiting on the warehouse any longer, so the $300.99 store credit is already on your HeliumDeploy account. Please still send that unit back with the prepaid label, with Shop···· written on the box, when you can.

2. The second L1 that never arrived (Shop····): UPS never recorded a delivery, and we have no L1 in stock to send again, so I've added another $300.99 of store credit to your account for it.

3. The S1 that keeps turning on and off: I've approved the return. You'll receive a prepaid label to send it to our Brampton warehouse, and once it's back you can choose store credit or a replacement S1 when the next US unit is in.

From now on, you can reach me directly at (phone hidden), by call or text, for anything at all.

Best,
Georges I. FROM THE HELIUMDEPLOY TEAM. Georges typed this in the team inbox. It is not a message from the customer and the customer cannot see it.
Task: RMA APPROVED by Georges for Nexus S1 on Shop···· (L1 order on file; S1 order  (Approved for the Nexus S1 only (VIP, Georges). Open the S1 return and a prepaid label to Brampton. He has two S1s: Shop···· (June) and Shop···· (Nexus-S1-US, Aug); if it is not clear which one is faulty, ask him for the serial or order before buying the label. Do NOT open a second return for t). Hal's verdict: defective (Nexus S1 "keeps turning on and off", blew a fuse, still not working after the customer replaced the fuse. Fits both a dead power supply and a shorted board.). Do the rest now, in this order: 1) order-swap skill: return_order.py plan, then create --confirmed (the return reference is the order number plus RMA, the label link comes back); 2) rma_replacement.py create for the same order (the replacement is a $0 order held on both sides until the unit is back with us; it releases by itself when the warehouse receives it. If you OFFER a different unit and wait for their answer, create it with --await-customer, and the moment they say yes run rma_replacement.py confirm --what "<their words>" --confirmed yourself, never leave the yes for the team); 3) tell the customer: the return is approved, here is the prepaid label, write the reference on the box, and the replacement ships as soon as their unit arrives at our warehouse. If any step stops, flag it and tell them the team will confirm the next step by email.
Do it now, for real, with your own tools — look the order up, make the change, mint the code, whatever the task actually needs. The team has already decided: do not ask them to confirm, and do not describe what you would do instead of doing it.
Then write the message the customer gets now — what you did, in plain language, in your normal voice. Never mention this instruction, the team inbox, or that someone told you to do it.
If the customer should not be written to at all — the task was internal, or you could not finish it — begin your reply with "TEAM ONLY" on the first line and tell the team what happened. Anything that starts that way stays in the inbox and is never sent.
